name: zero-slop
description: Zero Slop is a skill, not an AI model. GPT or another compatible model in the user's assistant reads and edits the draft; Zero Slop provides local writing checks, fact protection, guidance for final editorial passes, and private learning.

interface.shortDescription: Remove AI-sounding prose. Keep every fact. Verify the result.
interface.longDescription: Zero Slop is a skill, not an AI model. GPT or another compatible model in the user's assistant reads and edits the draft. Zero Slop provides local checks that point to exact phrases, protect facts, and verify the result. It also guides separate copy-editing and read-aloud passes. It can learn privately from later writer edits without retraining the model. Draft checks stay local and need no additional packages; the optional version check sends only a version query.
